subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Builds words with sounds learnt in two word families; groups words into sound families

show.line: Two families! Man, pan, can end in an. Hen, pen, ten end in en. Let's build them.

rounds.prompt: Listen. p, a, n. What word is it?
Listen. h, e, n. Tap the word.
Change the p in pen to t. What word do you make?
Which word is in the en family?
Which family? an or en? Sort the words.

hints: Listen to the middle sound. a or e?
Say the end part first. an. Then add the first sound.

beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! p, e, n is pen. Pan has a in the middle.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's blend together. p, e, n. Pen!

parent_line: Can build and sort words in the an and en families.
